title: Manager Fp&A
description:
Manager FP&A FLMC DACH Region 
 
 Job Summary 
 
If you are a Finance professional, Emerson has an exciting role for you! We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to work with our FP&A COE in Pune. 
The Senior FP&A Analyst role will support Emersons FLMC business activities in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, representing $400M+ in annual revenue. The role has a broad scope to include financial reporting process enhancements, portfolio forecasting, planning and analysis, as well as driving various finance initiatives that spread across legal entities and functional teams. The role is complex, demanding and can be a career booster/accelerator for highly motivated finance professional.
 
 In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 
 Establish planning and reporting cycles for assigned portfolios including regional consolidation and analysis activities Responsible for monthly reporting and forecasting activities in partnership with site operations and finance colleagues Drive site finance engagement and initiatives (across business and functional groups) designed to improve financial reporting/analysis and operating performance Lead FP&A rigor and simplification initiatives to drive timely, accurate and value-add analytics Build collaborative relationships with Site Finance, HQ Finance, GFS and Operating teams Support leadership team in preparation of budgets, operating plans, investment strategies, and resource planning Support financial reporting on all aspects of business on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis Maintain large datasets, systems & processes for reporting and analyzing operating results Partner with IT to drive system automation and process optimization Provide support for key initiatives & business investment activities Share best practices and drive One Emerson initiatives when applicable Support internal controls rigor, balance sheet reviews and audits 
 Who You Are: 
You promote high visibility of shared contributions to goals. You quickly and significantly take action in constantly evolving, unexpected situations. You actively seek input from pertinent sources to make timely and well-informed decisions. You handle the risk that comes with moving forward when the outcome is not certain.
 
 For This Role, You Will Need: 
 Finance Professional with 10+ years of work experience in FP&A Domain Hands on experience in ERP, MS Office, and reporting tools Analytical thinking ability and good team player Internal & External Stakeholder Management Cross functional interactions with Operations & Sales teams Self-starter, suggesting and implementing improvements to the processes. Balance stakeholder, Situational adaptability, manages complexities & Manages ambiguity. Strong team player having creative thinking and strategic solutions that help achieve organizational objectives. Ability to travel to Germany once or twice a year (for 1 to 2 weeks per trip) 
 Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart: 
 
 Qualified Chartered Accountant, CMA Basic understanding of Accounting Principles and US GAAP Excellent written and verbal communication skills System Knowledge of Oracle, SAP, Hyperion Financial Management Power BI or related presentation tools 
 
 Our Offer to You: 
 
By joining Emerson, you will be given the opportunity to make a difference through the work you do.
 
Emerson's compensation and benefits programs are designed to be competitive within the industry and local labor markets . We also offer a comprehensive medical and insurance coverage to meet the needs of our employees.
 
We are committed to creating a global workplace that supports diversity, equity and embraces inclusion . We welcome foreign nationals to join us through our Work Authorization Sponsorship .
 
We attract, develop, and retain exceptional people in an inclusive environment, where all employees can reach their greatest potential . We are dedicated to the ongoing development of our employees because we know that it is critical to our success as a global company.
 
We have established our Remote Work Policy for eligible roles to promote Work-Life Balance through a hybrid work set up where our team members can take advantage of working both from home and at the office.
 
Safety is paramount to us, and we are relentless in our pursuit to provide a Safe Working Environment across our global network and facilities.
 
Through our benefits, development opportunities, and an inclusive and safe work environment, we aim to create an organization our people are proud to represent.
 
 Our Culture & Commitment to You: 
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectivesbecause we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
We recognize the importance of employee well-being. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, an Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation, and holiday leave.
 
 
 WHY EMERSON 
 
 Our Commitment to Our People 
 
At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.
 
We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the worlds most complex problems for our customers, our communities, and the planet. Youll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.
 
At Emerson, youll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, lets go. Lets think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Lets go, together.
 
 
 
 
 ABOUT EMERSON 
 
Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.
 
With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.
 
We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether youre an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, youll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team lets go!

title: Accountant
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Accountant with 3-5 years of relevant experience in the manufacturing and/or trading industry. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in managing the complete accounting function, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, provisions, reconciliations and month-end closing. The candidate should also have a fair understanding of direct and indirect taxation and be comfortable working with ERP systems, preferably Oracle. The position will be based in Pune and may require occasional travel to the companys plants and other locations across India. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day accounting activities and maintain complete and accurate books of accounts. Handle the full accounting cycle, including journal entries, general ledger, reconciliations and month-end closing. Manage Accounts Payable (AP), including invoice processing, vendor reconciliations, payment preparation and ageing analysis. Manage Accounts Receivable (AR), including customer invoicing, receipts, customer reconciliations and collection follow-up. Monitor receivables and payables ageing and highlight overdue balances to management. Prepare and post monthly provisions, accruals and other adjusting entries. Assist with monthly, quarterly and annual closing and preparation of financial reports and schedules. Handle payroll accounting, including salary-related accounting entries and reconciliations. Perform regular bank, vendor, customer and general ledger reconciliations. Maintain proper supporting documentation and ensure compliance with accounting policies and internal controls. Assist with statutory audit, tax audit and internal audit requirements. Support direct and indirect tax compliance, including GST, TDS and other applicable taxes. Maintain appropriate records and documentation for tax and regulatory purposes. Assist in inventory and cost accounting activities and reconciliation of inventory-related balances. Ensure timely and accurate recording of transactions in the ERP system. Work closely with procurement, sales, operations, HR and other departments on accounting-related matters. Identify discrepancies and resolve accounting and reconciliation issues on a timely basis. Assist management with MIS reports, analysis and other finance-related requirements. Undertake occasional visits to company plants and other locations across India as required. Desired Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of accounting principles and practices. Hands-on experience in complete accounting / general ledger accounting. Good understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable processes. Practical experience in payroll accounting, provisions and accruals. Fair knowledge of direct and indirect taxation in India, including GST, TDS and other applicable taxes. Experience in manufacturing and/or trading environments is preferred. Working experience with an ERP system, preferably Oracle. Good knowledge of MS Excel and ability to work with accounting data and reports. Strong reconciliation and analytical skills. Good attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to work independently and meet deadlines. Good communication and coordination skills. Willingness to travel occasionally to plants and other company locations across India. Qualification & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or a related discipline. 3–5 years of relevant accounting experience in India. Experience in a manufacturing or trading company is preferred. Candidates with experience handling accounting independently, rather than only in a specialized accounting function, will be preferred. Key Attributes The successful candidate should be hands-on, organized, dependable and detail-oriented, with the ability to take ownership of accounting activities and work effectively in a fast-paced business environment. description:
Senior Executive / Asst Manager - Controlling 
 

 Your main responsibilities

Assess the Financial Impact and perform variance analysis at each category (Region, Rep, classification, PL, Codes) to prioritize those that contribute most to profitability and reduce losses. Document the root cause analysis and actions for continuous improvement
Contribute to defining and calculation of the activity rates and its OH cost allocations to the overhead cost based on the cost drivers. Analyse the trend y-o-y for its movement and improvement on the per unit cost.
Collaborates with Manager, Plant team and departments to explain results, make improvements, manage projects, identify inefficiencies, understand operations and lead the development of complex analysis

Analyse Make or Buy, negotiation and decisions in line with the yearly budget.
Perform and analyse the pre-post gap analysis of the job profitability and support management through improvement actions for generating higher contribution.
Support and assist in the audits including internal audit, Statutory audits, ASI assessment, tax audits and other related audits in compliance with group ON, DCD and finance SOPs

 Job Summary 
 The Accounts Payable Junior Specialist will be part of the Global Finance Shared Service Center and responsible for end-to-end Accounts Payable activities for global entities. Handle invoice exceptions, discrepancies, blocked invoices, and rejected cases, coordinating with relevant stakeholders for resolution. Manage recurring entries, credit notes, debit notes, and reversal postings. Understand basic accounting principles, including debit and credit entries and the accounting impact of vendor transactions. Perform vendor account reconciliations and open-item management, including investigation and resolution of outstanding items. Respond to vendor and internal stakeholder queries related to invoice status, payment status, discrepancies, and pending approvals. title: Accounts Payable Analyst I
description:
Accounts Payable Analyst I 
 
 Job Summary 
 Provide end-to-end support for the Accounts Payable and invoice processing process, ensuring timely and accurate processing of invoices and related transactions in SAP. The role is responsible for maintaining accurate Accounts Payable records, supporting timely supplier payments, meeting agreed service levels, complying with internal controls, and providing quality service to internal and external customers. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Receive, review, validate, process, and confirm invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and invoice provisions for purchases and expenses related to goods and services. Ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and contains the required approvals before processing transactions in SAP. Register invoices, debit notes, and credit notes daily by performing the appropriate SAP transactions to maintain timely and accurate Accounts Payable records. Meet agreed service levels for GBS Finance LAO customers, ensuring timely and quality delivery based on customer requirements. Review Purchase Orders associated with invoices and validate goods receipts and service acceptances to ensure compliance with three-way matching / triple validation requirements. Ensure supplier payment terms are correctly followed in accordance with company guidelines and support timely payment processing. Review and release authorized pre-registered invoices for accounting and payment after validating the required information. Provide documentation and information required by supported countries for audits, filing, analysis, and other Accounts Payable-related activities. Respond to inquiries from internal and external customers and provide guidance relating to processes, systems, documentation, and Accounts Payable requirements. Ensure activities are performed in accordance with applicable internal controls, data management requirements, and established procedures. Comply with applicable safety, health, environmental, loss-control, and regulatory requirements. Actively participate in and support continuous improvement and development initiatives promoted by the organization. Ensure compliance with established quality requirements, with a focus on meeting the expectations of internal and external customers. Support integration and implementation activities involving GBS services and customers. Provide SAP and process support for implementation projects and new team members, including process training where required. Participate in system updates and changes to SAP processes required by local or corporate markets. Support the creation, review, and updating of process manuals and standard operating procedures. 
 
 Functional / Business Skills 
 To succeed in this role, you will need the ability to: Maintain accurate records and controls for the companys Accounts Payable activities to support timely supplier payments. Maintain reliable information within financial systems to support reporting and business decision-making. Deliver quality and customer-focused service to supported markets and stakeholders. Follow established systems, controls, procedures, and quality standards within the Accounts Payable function. Use SAP Finance functionality to process and record transactions related to Accounts Payable. Work with Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) or similar invoice management solutions for the receipt, control, and registration of supplier payment documents. Apply knowledge of financial controls, accounting controls, performance metrics, financial systems, and continuous improvement within Accounts Payable processes. Identify, investigate, and resolve routine Accounts Payable issues in a timely manner. Develop strong expertise in AP transaction processing and share process knowledge with colleagues when required. Work accurately in a transaction-driven environment while meeting agreed timelines and service levels. 
 
 About You 
 You are detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working with financial transactions and systems. You understand the importance of accuracy and timeliness when processing invoices and supporting supplier payments. You bring: Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities. A customer-focused mindset. Ability to organize and prioritize work effectively. Willingness to learn new processes and systems. Ability to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders. Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Interest in continuous improvement and developing expertise in Accounts Payable. 
 
 Key / Required Qualifications and Experience 
 Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Accounting, or a related field. 2-5 years of relevant experience, preferably in Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, Accounting, or a related area. Basic understanding of Accounts Payable and accounting processes. Ability to work with invoices, purchase orders, financial documentation, and transaction data. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. 
 
 Other Requirements 
 Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills. Knowledge of SAP is desirable. Exposure to SAP Finance / Accounts Payable functionality is an advantage. Knowledge or exposure to VIM (Vendor Invoice Management) is desirable. English proficiency is desirable. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Previous internship, apprenticeship, or professional exposure to Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, or Accounting. Exposure to invoice processing, purchase orders, goods receipts, service entries, or three-way matching. Exposure to a GBS, Shared Services, or Finance Operations environment. Basic understanding of financial controls and audit requirements. Experience using SAP, ERP, or invoice management systems. Customer-service orientation with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Strong learning agility and willingness to build expertise in Accounts Payable processes.

Role & responsibilities JOB DESCRIPTION Senior Financial Specialist To manage and coordinate statutory audits, group audits, treasury operations, month-end closing activities, financial reporting, forecasting, transfer pricing compliance, and balance sheet reviews. The role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of financial information, compliance with applicable statutory and group reporting requirements, effective cash flow management, and adherence to internal financial controls and company policies. Key Responsibilities 1) Statutory Audit and Financial Statements * Manage and coordinate the statutory audit process, ensuring timely completion in accordance with applicable statutory requirements and reporting deadlines. * Prepare and finalize financial statements, cash flow statements, and schedules of assets and liabilities in coordination with the Finance Manager. * Reconcile the trial balance with the finalized financial statements and SAP records to ensure accuracy and consistency. 2) Group Audit and IFRS Reporting * Independently manage and coordinate the year-end group audit process as of December. 3) Treasury and Cash Management * Manage banking facilities and coordinate with banks to ensure the smooth functioning of day-to-day treasury operations. * Ensure timely completion of monthly, quarterly, and annual banking compliances and reporting requirements. * Analyze cash flow requirements to support liquidity management and effective utilization of available funds. * Coordinate the preparation, processing, and submission of customer and vendor Letter of Credit (LC) documentation. 4) Month-End Closing Activities * Prepare and post recurring journal entries relating to treasury and other assigned accounting areas. * Review foreign exchange accounting entries and validate realized and unrealized foreign exchange gains or losses. * Prepare fixed deposit interest accrual workings and ensure accurate and timely posting of related journal entries. 5) Monthly Global Reporting * Prepare and submit the monthly Net Financial Position (NFP) breakdown in accordance with group reporting requirements. * Prepare and circulate daily cash position reports to support cash monitoring and liquidity management. * Report credit facilities, banking limits, and compliance with applicable bank conditions. * Prepare and review cash flow reports, highlighting significant movements, variances, and potential liquidity requirements. * Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timely submission of global financial and treasury reports. * Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to validate reported information and resolve reporting discrepancies. 6) Financial Forecasting and Budget Monitoring * Collect and verify financial forecast inputs received from Operations, Sales, and other relevant departments. * Prepare fixed-cost forecasts in accordance with the approved budget and applicable assumptions. * Prepare and circulate forecast updates three times per month, in line with the established reporting schedule. 7) Transfer Pricing and Tax Compliance * Coordinate the preparation, review, and filing of applicable transfer pricing reports, forms, and supporting documentation in accordance with the Income-tax Act, 1961. * Coordinate responses to tax assessment notices, prepare the required information, and liaise with external consultants for timely submission. 8) Balance Sheet Schedules and Monthly Analysis * Prepare and maintain monthly balance sheet schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for all assigned accounting areas. * Perform monthly balance sheet reviews and submit the findings to the Finance Manager. 9) Quarterly Group IFRS Package * Prepare and consolidate the quarterly IFRS reporting package in accordance with group reporting instructions and deadlines. 10). Internal Controls and Process Improvement * Ensure adherence to internal financial controls, delegated authority limits, and company policies. * Maintain appropriate records and support documentation for audit, compliance, and management review. . Key Skills and Competencies * Strong knowledge of financial accounting, financial reporting, and balance sheet reconciliations. * Working knowledge of IFRS and group reporting requirements. * Experience in statutory audits, group audits, and audit coordination. * Knowledge of treasury operations, banking facilities, foreign exchange accounting, and cash flow management. * Understanding of Indian tax compliance and transfer pricing reporting requirements. * Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Excel, with the ability to analyze financial data and prepare reports. * Ability to manage multiple deliverables and meet strict reporting and compliance deadlines.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Role Overview The Finance Manager will be responsible for managing the company's financial operations and ensuring strong financial controls, accurate reporting, statutory compliance and effective working-capital management. The role will work closely with the Management, Sales, Projects, Procurement, HR, Operations and Product teams to support business decisions through timely and accurate financial analysis. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Planning & Analysis Prepare annual budgets, financial plans and periodic financial forecasts. Monitor actual performance against budgets and analyse variances. Prepare monthly and quarterly financial MIS for management review. Analyse revenue, gross margins, operating costs and profitability. Provide financial insights and recommendations to management for business decisions. Support financial evaluation of new products, projects and business initiatives. 2. Accounting & Financial Operations Oversee day-to-day accounting and finance operations. Review General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and bank reconciliations. Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing. Review provisions, accruals, expenses and revenue recognition. Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial records. Coordinate with internal and external auditors. 3. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management Prepare and monitor weekly and monthly cash-flow forecasts. Monitor receivables, payables and working-capital requirements. Track customer collections and overdue receivables. Coordinate with Sales teams to improve collection efficiency. Plan vendor payments based on cash-flow availability and business priorities. Identify opportunities to improve the company's working-capital cycle. 4. Budgeting & Cost Control Prepare and monitor departmental and company-level budgets. Track actual expenses against approved budgets. Analyse significant cost variances and recommend corrective actions. Establish appropriate financial controls and approval mechanisms. Identify opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiency. 5. Business & Project Finance Monitor project-wise revenue, costs and profitability. Support project teams with budgeting, costing and financial tracking. Analyse product and project margins. Support management in commercial evaluation and pricing decisions. Provide financial inputs for new business opportunities and strategic initiatives. 6. Accounts Receivable & Payable Monitor customer outstanding and ageing reports. Coordinate with Sales and Business teams for timely collections. Review customer credit limits and payment terms. Monitor vendor outstanding and payment schedules. Ensure timely processing and settlement of vendor payments. Maintain appropriate controls over customer and vendor accounts. 7. Statutory Compliance & Audit Ensure timely compliance with applicable GST, TDS, Income Tax and other statutory requirements. Review GST reconciliations and tax-related reports. Coordinate with statutory, tax and internal auditors. Ensure timely preparation and submission of required financial and statutory reports. Maintain proper documentation and records for audits and compliance. 8. ERP & Finance Process Improvement Manage and improve finance processes within the company's ERP system. Ensure accurate financial data and reporting through ERPNext/Frappe ERP. Develop and improve finance MIS and dashboards. Identify opportunities for automation of financial processes. Strengthen controls across procurement, sales, inventory, projects and finance processes. 9. Management Reporting Prepare and present periodic management reports covering: Revenue vs Budget Gross Margin & Profitability Budget vs Actual Cash Flow Accounts Receivable Ageing Accounts Payable Ageing Working Capital Project Profitability Expense Analysis Inventory / Stock Position Business Unit Performance Financial Forecasts 
 Required Qualifications & Experience CA / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com or equivalent qualification. 10- 15 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts. Experience in IT, Telecom, Networking, Technology, OEM, System Integration, IT Services or B2B businesses will be preferred. Strong experience in financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and cash-flow management. Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, Income Tax and statutory compliance. Experience in managing audits and financial controls. Experience with ERP/accounting systems. Strong MS Excel and financial analysis skills. ERPNext/Frappe experience will be an added advantage. 
 Key Competencies Strong financial and analytical skills Business and commercial acumen Excellent attention to detail Strong ownership and accountability Problem-solving and decision-making ability Good communication and stakeholder-management skills Ability to work with senior management and cross-functional teams Strong understanding of financial controls and processes Ability to work in a fast-paced and growth-oriented environment

description:

Job Description - 
 Purchase Manager 

 Employee Name: Santosh pawar
 Company: Anjali T. Precision
 Position: Purchase Manager
 Department: Purchase
 Reporting To: Plant Head / Operations Head
 Location: Nighoje & Chikhali Unit 
 Employement Type: Full Time
 ______________________________________________________________________________________ 

 Position Summary 
The Purchase Head is responsible for leading and managing the organization's end-to-end procurement function by developing strategic sourcing plans, ensuring uninterrupted availability of raw materials, bought-out parts, consumables, tooling, capital equipment, services, and indirect materials required for manufacturing operations. The role is accountable for driving procurement excellence through effective supplier management, cost optimization, inventory planning, commercial negotiations, statutory compliance, and cross-functional collaboration.
The incumbent shall establish robust procurement processes, strengthen supplier relationships, improve procurement efficiency, and ensure the achievement of Quality, Cost, and Delivery (QCD) objectives. The Purchase Head is also responsible for leading the purchase team, monitoring departmental KPIs, implementing digital task management practices, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational performance and business profitability.

 Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 1. Procurement Strategy & Planning 
 Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with the company's business objectives and operational requirements. Prepare annual procurement plans, sourcing strategies, and departmental budgets. Ensure uninterrupted availability of raw materials, bought-out parts, consumables, tooling, capital equipment, maintenance spares, and indirect materials. Establish procurement plans based on production forecasts, inventory levels, and customer demand. Drive strategic sourcing initiatives to improve procurement efficiency and supply chain reliability. Support business expansion through effective procurement planning and supplier development. 
 2. Vendor Development & Supplier Management 
 Identify, evaluate, qualify, and approve new suppliers based on Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Technical Capability. Build long-term strategic relationships with key suppliers. Conduct supplier audits, capability assessments, and performance reviews. Monitor supplier performance using predefined KPIs and implement corrective actions where required. Lead supplier development initiatives to improve quality, delivery performance, responsiveness, and cost competitiveness. Resolve supplier-related quality, delivery, and commercial issues in coordination with internal stakeholders. 
 3. Purchase Operations & Material Procurement 
 Oversee procurement of all direct and indirect materials required for manufacturing operations. Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders (POs). Monitor order acknowledgements, supplier commitments, and delivery schedules. Coordinate with PPC, Production, Stores, Quality, Maintenance, NPD, and Finance to ensure smooth material flow. Ensure critical materials are available to avoid production interruptions. Monitor procurement lead times and expedite urgent material requirements whenever necessary. Ensure adherence to approved procurement procedures and authorization matrices. 
 4. Commercial Negotiation & Cost Management 
 Lead commercial negotiations for pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, warranty conditions, and contractual obligations. Develop and implement annual cost reduction and value engineering initiatives. Analyse market trends, commodity prices, and raw material fluctuations to support strategic sourcing decisions. Identify opportunities for supplier consolidation and procurement optimization. Achieve cost savings without compromising product quality or delivery performance. Monitor procurement budgets and control overall purchasing expenditure. 
 5. Contract Management & Compliance 
 Finalize supplier contracts, annual rate agreements, and long-term supply agreements. Ensure all commercial agreements comply with company policies and statutory regulations. Maintain procurement documentation in accordance with ISO 9001, IATF 16949, and internal quality management systems. Ensure compliance with applicable legal, environmental, and ethical procurement standards. Support internal, customer, and external audits by maintaining complete procurement records and documentation. 
 6. Inventory & Supply Chain Coordination 
 Monitor inventory levels and procurement schedules to maintain optimum stock levels. Coordinate closely with Stores to minimize excess inventory while preventing stock-outs. Review slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete inventory and initiate corrective actions. Collaborate with PPC and Production to align procurement with manufacturing schedules. Improve inventory turnover through effective procurement planning. 
 7. Cross-Functional Coordination 
 Work closely with PPC, Production, Stores, Quality Assurance, Finance, NPD, Maintenance, HR, and Operations to ensure smooth procurement operations. Support new product development by sourcing new materials, components, and suppliers. Participate in cross-functional meetings to resolve supply chain challenges. Ensure effective communication between suppliers and internal departments. 
 8. Team Leadership & Performance Management 
 Lead, mentor, and develop the Purchase Department team. Allocate responsibilities and monitor workload distribution. Establish departmental objectives, KPIs, and performance targets. Conduct periodic performance reviews and provide coaching for continuous improvement. Identify training needs and support employee skill development. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning. 
 9. MIS, Reporting & Performance Monitoring 
 Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly procurement reports to management. Monitor procurement KPIs and supplier performance metrics. Analyse procurement data to identify cost-saving opportunities and operational improvements. Prepare monthly purchase budget reports and cost-saving analysis. Track procurement lead times, supplier delivery performance, and purchasing efficiency. Maintain accurate procurement records and dashboards for management review. 
 10. Digital Task Management & Reporting 
The Purchase Head shall ensure disciplined implementation of digital task management and performance reporting across the Purchase Department.
 Responsibilities 
 Use Microsoft Planner daily to plan, assign, monitor, and review all departmental procurement activities. Review all assigned tasks at the beginning of each working day and ensure timely completion within defined deadlines. Assign and delegate procurement activities to Purchase Managers, Purchase Engineers, Buyers, and departmental team members through Microsoft Planner. Monitor task progress, follow up on pending activities, and ensure timely closure of all assigned tasks. Update task status with appropriate remarks, supporting documents, and completion evidence. Conduct daily Planner review meetings with the purchase team to monitor operational progress. Escalate overdue or delayed procurement activities to the Operations Head along with corrective action plans. Fill and review the Daily Progress Report in the designated Google Sheet before the end of every working day. Ensure all completed work, pending purchase orders, supplier follow-ups, delivery delays, commercial issues, and action plans are accurately recorded. Maintain complete transparency, accountability, and digital tracking of all procurement activities. 
 11. Continuous Improvement 
 Drive Lean Procurement and continuous improvement initiatives. Identify opportunities to automate procurement processes and improve operational efficiency. Standardize procurement procedures and documentation. Reduce procurement cycle time and improve supplier responsiveness. Promote innovation, value engineering, and strategic sourcing practices to enhance business competitiveness. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Operational KPIs 
 Purchase Cost Savings Supplier On-Time Delivery (OTD) Supplier Quality Performance (PPM) Procurement Lead Time Purchase Order Cycle Time Inventory Optimisation Vendor Development Purchase Budget Compliance Material Availability for Production Emergency Purchase Reduction Financial KPIs 
 Annual Cost Reduction Procurement Budget Adherence Cost Avoidance Through Negotiation Inventory Carrying Cost Reduction Digital KPIs 
 100% Microsoft Planner Compliance On-Time Task Completion Task Delegation Effectiveness Daily Google Sheet Reporting Compliance Departmental Task Closure Rate Compliance KPIs 
 ISO & IATF Compliance Supplier Audit Compliance Procurement Documentation Accuracy Zero Procurement Policy Violations 
 Educational Qualification 
 Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline. MBA in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or Materials Management will be preferred. 
 Experience 
 1218 years of experience in manufacturing procurement, sourcing, and supply chain management. Minimum 5 years of experience in a leadership role managing procurement teams. Experience in automotive, precision engineering, CNC machining, industrial manufacturing, or export-oriented organizations will be preferred. 
 Technical Skills 
 Strategic Sourcing Vendor Development & Supplier Evaluation Procurement Planning Commercial Negotiation Contract Management Supply Chain Management Inventory Planning Cost Analysis & Value Engineering ERP Systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, PMTrack ERP, etc.) Advanced Microsoft Excel Microsoft Planner Google Sheets Power BI (Preferred) MIS & KPI Reporting ISO 9001 & IATF 16949 Knowledge 
 Behavioural Competencies 
 Strategic Leadership Commercial Acumen Strong Negotiation Skills Decision Making Analytical Thinking Financial Awareness Planning & Organising Cross-Functional Coordination Problem Solving Team Leadership & Coaching Communication & Influencing Skills Accountability Change Management Result Orientation 
 Authority Matrix 
The Purchase Head is authorised to:
 Approve procurement plans, sourcing strategies, and supplier selection recommendations. Negotiate and approve commercial terms within the approved authority limits. Allocate departmental responsibilities and monitor team performance. Assign and review departmental tasks through Microsoft Planner. Recommend supplier approval, suspension, or development actions. Escalate procurement risks and supply chain issues to the Operations Head. Recommend procurement policy improvements and strategic sourcing initiatives. 
 Internal Working Relationships 
 Operations Head Plant Head PPC Department Production Department Stores & Warehouse Quality Assurance Finance & Accounts NPD Department Maintenance Department HR & Administration Dispatch & Logistics 
 External Working Relationships

title: Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI/Senior Unit Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early. In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend. We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds. Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules. 

 Responsibilities 
 As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately. Synthetic Testing: Once the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan. So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today" and see what the AI says. Does the AI say yesDoes it calculate the early payment fee correctlyWhat if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spellingWhat if you type in a mix of Hindi and EnglishWhat if you pretend to be very angryDoes the AI still understand and stay politeYou will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly. LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain): The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to. If a customer types, "What is my balance", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters. As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI." You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks. Visualisations: Chatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen. Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations. Let\'s say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly. Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn\'t make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use. Product Switching: Imagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand." At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing. We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later. Conversation Flows: A normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows. You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen. 
Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help" -> Arrow points to Box 2. 
Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3. 
Box 3: The system checks if the customer\'s phone number is verified. 
If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4. 
If No -> Arrow points to Box 5. 
Box 4: Show the statement on the screen. 
Box 5: Ask the customer to type in a one-time password (OTP). You have to map out every single path the conversation could possibly take. You have to think of all the "what ifs." What if the customer types the wrong password What if the customer stops replying and walks away from their phone What if the internet crashes You must draw a box and an arrow for every single situation. These flowcharts become the actual instruction manual for the engineers. They look at your map and write

title: Associate Energy Market Analyst (Support - SQL Focused)
description:
Job Summary 
 This role provides frontline support for consultants and customers using the Adapt2 (A2) ISO product, investigating shadow settlements and database-dependent processes in Microsoft SQL Server. Responsibilities include troubleshooting T-SQL stored procedures, tracing report downloads and parsing, validating market data, and supporting complex issue resolution with senior analysts. As a trusted advisor, this role builds client relationships while collaborating with internal teams to deliver effective solutions. Strong communication skills are essential to explain technical findings to diverse audiences, ensuring reliable service delivery and customer success. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Provide frontline technical support for A2 customers and consultants, investigating issues and escalating tier 3 cases with clear diagnostic evidence. Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor to help optimize their use of the A2 enterprise solution. Collaborate with Software Development, Implementation/Delivery, and Product Management to reproduce A2 issues, communicate findings, and validate customer solutions. Analyze A2 data and job status in Microsoft SQL Server to identify recurring issues, recommend improvements, and contribute to long-term resolutions. Troubleshoot and optimize complex T-SQL stored procedures for A2 shadow settlements, allocations and transmission profit and loss; validate results. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Microsoft SQL Server Knowledge: Strong T-SQL skills in joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions and stored procedures; use SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) to investigate A2 data discrepancies and query performance. Technical Adaptability: Demonstrated experience in or eagerness to develop Python skills for A2 data validation, transformation, support automation and analysis. API Testing: Experience testing RESTful APIs, SOAP APIs and A2 integrations using Postman, Swagger and web services; interpret requests, responses and errors. Good to have: Microsoft Power BI, Azure Cloud, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines for deploying microservices to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Communication skills: Follow written and oral instructions, document A2 reproduction steps and SQL findings, and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Computer Science or Engineering background preferred. 
 
 Desired but not required 
 Power Settlements Knowledge: Experience or understanding of power market settlements, transaction processing and reconciliation of A2 settlement results. Microsoft Azure Ecosystem knowledge: Understanding of Azure cloud services, storage and infrastructure supporting A2 integrations, report downloads and application operations. Energy Power Market Knowledge: Familiarity with ISO and RTO operations, market reports and settlement data, including operating dates, participants and report versions.

title: Accounts And Finance Manager
description:
Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Accounts & Finance Manager to manage the company's accounting, finance, taxation, compliance, reporting, budgeting, and financial control functions. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate financial reporting, effective cash-flow management, statutory compliance, and providing financial insights to management for business decision-making. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Accounting & Financial Reporting Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, and Bank Reconciliation . Ensure timely closure of monthly, quarterly, and annual books of accounts. Prepare and review P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement, and MIS reports . Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting records in accordance with applicable accounting standards. Monitor receivables, payables, advances, provisions, and outstanding balances. 2. Taxation & Statutory Compliance Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, PF, ESIC, Professional Tax , and other applicable statutory requirements. Review GST returns, reconciliations, input tax credit, and related documentation. Coordinate for tax assessments, notices, audits, and statutory requirements. Ensure timely filing of returns and payment of statutory dues. 3. Budgeting & Financial Planning Prepare and monitor annual budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow projections . Analyze actual performance against budgets and identify significant variances. Support management in financial planning, cost optimization, and business decisions. Monitor working capital and optimize cash utilization. 4. Audit & Compliance Coordinate with Statutory Auditors, Internal Auditors, Tax Consultants, and other external agencies . Ensure timely completion of statutory and internal audits. Maintain proper documentation and financial records for audit purposes. Implement and monitor appropriate financial controls and processes. 5. Cash Flow & Banking Manage daily cash-flow requirements and fund planning. Coordinate with banks regarding payments, banking transactions, loans, guarantees, LC/BG, and other banking requirements. Monitor bank balances, cash requirements, and working-capital position. Ensure timely vendor payments while maintaining adequate liquidity. 6. Management MIS & Analysis Prepare and present periodic financial MIS and management reports . Provide analysis on revenue, profitability, expenses, working capital, and cash flow. Identify financial risks, deviations, and opportunities for cost control. Provide data-driven financial inputs to senior management. 7. Costing & Commercial Finance Review product/project costing and profitability. Analyze material, manpower, overhead, and project costs. Support commercial teams in pricing and margin analysis. Monitor project-wise profitability and cost overruns, where applicable. 8. Team Management Lead and supervise the Accounts & Finance team. Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of accounting and compliance activities. Review team performance and provide guidance on accounting and finance processes. Develop and improve finance processes, controls, and SOPs. 9. Process Improvement & ERP Ensure effective utilization of ERP/accounting software for financial transactions and reporting. Identify opportunities to automate and streamline finance processes. Maintain appropriate internal controls and authorization mechanisms. Ensure proper master-data and financial transaction controls.

Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly trillion in assets. This white-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human-in-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks. As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the Alternatives Data Ops team is responsible for the human-in-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. This role will include managing a team and reviewing Private Fund statements, modifying data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocessing the data within SLAs. The Alternatives Data Ops team plays a critical role in the success of Addepars Alternatives offering and requires daily communications with the Alternatives Product Team, Machine Learning Operations, clients, data providers (GPs and Fund Admins), and additional personnel across the organization. title: Service Desk Quality Analyst
description:
OVERVIEW 
The Service Desk Quality Analyst supports the Service Desk operation by ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and quality of ticket handling and documentation. While this role primarily operates behind the scenes, it may occasionally involve handling service tickets to support operational needs or gain deeper insight into service patterns. Key responsibilities include reviewing ticket coding for accuracy, interpreting dashboards, identifying recurring issues, and converting data into actionable insights for service leads. Tasks involve auditing tickets, flagging miscategorized entries, reporting on Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance, monitoring backlog trends, and assisting problem management through thorough data analysis. Acting as an extension of the quality function, this role plays a critical part in enhancing ticket hygiene, improving team performance, and delivering operational insights that drive continuous service desk improvements.
 DESCRIPTION The Service Desk Quality Analyst is a mid-level role that works closely with the Service Desk team and leadership to: Monitor incoming new tickets in the Service Desk system to ensure timely and accurate assignment to the appropriate team members Monitor incoming escalations to promptly identify high-priority or complex issues requiring immediate attention from Senior Analysts or Service Desk management Maintain real-time oversight of ticket queues and escalation paths to prevent bottlenecks and service delays Provide backup support to Service Desk Analysts by handling tickets as needed during peak periods, absences, or resource shortages, helping maintain consistent service levels Review and audit service desk tickets for coding accuracy and categorization Identify and flag misclassified or incomplete entries Monitor SLA compliance and generate weekly/monthly performance reports Analyze incident and request trends to identify recurring issues and opportunities for automation or documentation improvements Track backlog trends and report on resolution times Provide support in problem management by conducting comprehensive, data-driven root cause analysis Interpret dashboards and translate technical data into clear, actionable insights for service improvement Contribute to quality improvement initiatives by highlighting gaps and supporting process documentation Use dashboards (e.g., Zoho ManageEngine, ServiceNow, Jira) to extract performance insights Assist with the standardization of ticket documentation practices Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistency in incident reporting and documentation Full-time role with rotational shifts based on business requirements Collaborate with Service Desk leads and quality teams to translate data insights into actionable recommendations Assist in documenting known issues, process updates, and best practices to support continuous improvement initiatives Participate in team meetings and quality reviews, sharing insights that help drive service enhancements Track and analyze the volume and types of escalations to identify training needs for Service Desk staff Complete all other tasks deemed appropriate for the role and assigned by the manager/supervisor. 
 REQUIRED SKILLS Process Documentation skills Advanced Excel skills Ability to deep dive into numbers and draw conclusions Understanding of Root Cause Analysis Strong reasoning and analytical skills Time Management and prioritization Multi-tasking capabilities Ability to manage several priorities at once Ability to focus for long periods of time to determine a solution Strong communication skills (both written and verbal) Organize thoughts and communicate verbal messages appropriately to listeners and situations Demonstrated proficiency in grammar and typing skills Comfortable with repetitive tasks Good attention to detail and willingness to learn Ability to work independently Willingness to cooperate with others and work for the greater good. 
 REQUIRED EXPEREINCE & QUALIFICATIONS A year of phone, email, or chat support experience in IT Service Desk, Helpdesk, Technical Support, or US customer support experience Two years of data analysis and reporting or a Bachelors degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field Familiar with ITIL and its processes, specifically those related to Service Request, Incident, Change, and Problem Management Knowledge of Customer Service principles and practices Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., Zoho Manage Engine, ServiceNow, Jira) Understanding of SLA metrics Experience in process documentation 
 DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE Analytics / Data analysis and reporting in a Call Center or Service Desk environment Work experience in the Pharma industry Knowledge of computer fundamentals, software/web application Strong troubleshooting skills.

title: Manager - Credit Risk
description:
About bluCognition bluCognition is an AI-powered commercial credit intelligence company serving lenders and financial institutions. Our platform combines commercial credit data contributed by 150+ lenders with AI-driven analytics, banking data and fraud detection to help our clients make faster, better credit decisions. Our product suite includes bluSense, which converts bank statements into standardized, categorized transaction data with real-time financial insights, and FraudLens, which detects document tampering and first-party fraud. Alongside our data products, we run a managed services business supporting underwriting, fraud review, and KYC/KYB and sanctions screening operations for our clients, with teams across North America, Asia and Europe. 
 About the Role We are looking for a Manager Credit Risk to lead credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements. The role will combine hands-on credit expertise, client management, solution development and team leadership. The ideal candidate should have strong financial analysis and commercial credit underwriting expertise, sound credit judgment, excellent client communication skills, and the ability to translate client requirements into practical processes and solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities Lead delivery of credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements, ensuring quality, timelines and client requirements are met. Perform and review financial and credit analysis, including financial statements, ratio analysis, cash flows, liquidity, leverage, profitability, working capital, AR/AP aging and other key credit indicators. Monitor credit portfolios and risk trends, identifying emerging risks, changes in financial performance and other indicators requiring attention, and communicate relevant insights to clients. Conduct quantitative and qualitative credit assessment, including business model, industry, customer concentration, debt obligations, contracts and supporting documentation, to identify key risks and form a credit view. Own client communication and requirement gathering, translating business needs into underwriting frameworks, processes, SOPs and practical risk/technology solutions. Manage and develop internal team, including work allocation, quality review, coaching and capability building. Drive process improvement, standardization, automation and risk-monitoring initiatives, and proactively communicate key risks, trends and recommendations to clients. 
 What we are looking for 5 years of experience in commercial credit risk, financial analysis or risk consulting, preferably within banking, lending, fintech or financial services; experience with US, Canada or LATAM markets preferred. Strong understanding of financial statement analysis, credit appraisal, ratio analysis, cash-flow and working-capital assessment, with sound credit judgment. Strong credit judgment and attention to detail, including ability to identify financial, operational and qualitative risks from multiple information sources. Excellent client-facing, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand ambiguous requirements and develop practical solutions. Experience managing/reviewing junior team members and taking ownership of project delivery. Experience with process design, SOP development, automation or analytics initiatives. Should have strong understanding of Advanced MS Excel and financial analysis/modeling skills. Exposure to credit underwriting, financial spreading, banking/transaction data or risk analytics platforms is an advantage. 
 Educational Qualifications CA / CA Inter / Semi-qualified CA preferred. Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline. Equivalent qualifications with relevant credit risk/underwriting experience may also be considered.

Key Skills: Credit Underwriting,Credit Analysis,Financial Statement Analysis,Credit Risk Analysis,Risk Management,Underwriting,Financial analysis,Credit management

title: Walk-in || Associate Finance Executive (Account Receivable) - Immediate Joiners
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 19 Sep
Timing: 9.00 AM - 12.00 PM
Venue: 1201, 12th Floor, OneHQ, Balewadi, New Baner-Hinjewadi Link Road, Pune, Maharashtra 411045
Contact: Siyona (9175448085)

Role summary You will handle the day-to-day financial operations at Provakil processing invoices, tracking payments, managing vendor accounts, and ensuring every transaction is recorded accurately and on time. This is the operational backbone of the finance function.
 The role spans accounts receivable (invoicing, payment follow-ups, client coordination). Youll work closely with the Finance Manager and coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams to keep financial operations running smoothly. Accuracy is non-negotiable in this role - every invoice, every entry, every reconciliation needs to be correct the first time. 
 What youll do Accounts receivable • Raise tax invoices and proforma invoices for enterprise clients and share them within defined timelines no delays in billing Follow up with clients for payment collection: track outstanding amounts, make follow-up calls, and update payment status on internal systems Book payments received from clients accurately in the accounting system match payments to invoices, flag discrepancies, and reconcile regularly Upload tax invoices on client vendor portals as required many enterprise clients have specific portal-based submission processes Prepare and share balance confirmation statements as per client requests Follow up with clients on TDS receivables track TDS deductions, collect TDS certificates, and ensure they are accounted for correctly 
 Accounts payable • Prepare and maintain the expense register track all company expenses with accurate categorisation and documentation Issue Form 16A (TDS certificates) to vendors within prescribed timelines Manage petty cash: process petty cash vouchers, maintain the petty cash register, and ensure regular reconciliation 
 Financial record-keeping & compliance support • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all financial transactions in the accounting system every entry should be audit-ready Prepare supporting schedules and documentation for internal and external audits when required Maintain organised digital and physical records of invoices, receipts, contracts, and compliance documents 
 Internal coordination Coordinate with the Sales and Account Management teams on client invoicing: billing schedules, special terms, credit notes, and invoice corrections Respond to internal queries on invoice status, payment timelines, and vendor account details in a timely and accurate manner 
 What success looks like in your first 60 days First 30 days Complete onboarding and understand Provakils financial setup: accounting software, banking relationships, client billing structure, and vendor payment processes Familiarise yourself with the client list and their invoicing requirements: billing cycles, portal submissions, TDS processes, and payment terms Shadow the existing finance operations to understand how invoices are raised, payments are tracked, and vendor bills are processed Start processing routine transactions independently: invoice uploads, payment bookings, and expense entries under supervision Review the current state of receivables and payables understand whats outstanding and where follow-ups are needed 
 Days 31-60 Handle the full accounts receivable cycle independently: invoice raising, client follow-ups, payment booking, and TDS tracking Take ownership of at least one recurring financial task end-to-end (e.g., weekly receivables follow-up, petty cash reconciliation, or vendor portal submissions) Support the Finance Manager with your first month-end close prepare data, reconcile accounts, and flag any open items 

 Must-have skills 2-4 years of experience in finance operations, accounting, or a similar role internships in accounting firms or finance departments count Working knowledge of accounts receivable and accounts payable processes: invoicing, payment tracking, vendor management, and reconciliation Basic understanding of Indian taxation: GST (input and output), TDS/TCS, and how they apply to invoices and vendor payments Hands-on proficiency with accounting software (Tally, Zoho Books, or equivalent) and MS Excel for data entry, tracking, and basic reporting Accuracy and attention to detail that is non-negotiable financial data has zero tolerance for errors, and your work must reflect that standard Good communication skills youll be calling clients for payment follow-ups and coordinating with vendors, so you need to be clear, professional, and persistent Organised approach to work you manage multiple invoices, deadlines, and records simultaneously without letting anything slip 
 Good-to-have skills • B.Com, M.Com, or equivalent qualification in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance Experience working with enterprise client billing processes, vendor portals, and procurement teams Familiarity with bank reconciliation processes and month-end closing activities Exposure to statutory compliance workflows: GST return filing, TDS return filing, or audit preparation Experience in a SaaS or technology company where subscription-based billing is the revenue model 
 What youll learn in this role End-to-end financial operations at a growing technology company — AR, AP, compliance, and reporting in one role, giving you a broad foundation in corporate finance How enterprise billing and collections work in a B2B SaaS business — subscription models, procurement processes, and the financial mechanics that drive recurring revenue Working knowledge of Indian statutory compliance (GST, TDS, audits) through hands-on execution, not just theory 
 About Provakil Provakil is one of India’s leading legaltech platforms, helping enterprises manage litigation, contracts, compliance, and intellectual property through a single integrated product. We serve 200+ enterprise clients including Fortune 500 companies. We’re a product-first company with deep domain expertise in Indian legal operations. The team is a mix of engineers, lawyers, product thinkers, and business operators — and we’re building the operational backbone to support the next phase of scale.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Role & responsibilities Core Responsibilities: 1 
 Financial Accounting & Reporting: Oversee accurate accounting and reporting of all financial transactions in compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and company policies. Ensure timely and reliable financial statements and reports to support strategic decision-making. 2 
 Day-to-Day Accounting Operations: Supervise daily accounting functions including Accounts Receivable (AR) , Accounts Payable (AP) , general ledger, journal entries, and bank reconciliations to ensure data integrity and adherence to internal controls. 3 
 AR & AP Review: Review Accounts Receivable for timely billing, collections, and credit management; oversee Accounts Payable for vendor payments, reconciliations, and compliance with internal authorization processes. Conduct periodic aging and working capital analysis. 4 
 Treasury and Cash Flow Management: Monitor customer receipts and vendor payments to maintain efficient cash flow and working capital. Prepare and review cash flow statements (actual vs forecast) to ensure optimal liquidity planning. Maintain strong banking relationships , manage fund movements, and ensure optimal utilization of banking facilities. 5 
 Capex Monitoring and Capitalization: Review and track Capex projects , ensuring correct classification and capitalization as per Ind AS 16. Maintain fixed asset registers, monitor CWIP, and ensure accurate depreciation accounting. 6 
 Month-End and Year-End Closing: Lead monthly and annual closing activities including reconciliations, accruals, provisions, and preparation of financial reports within strict timelines. 7 
 MIS, Forecasting, and Budget Reporting: Prepare and consolidate MIS reports , budgets , and financial forecasts using Oracle HFM (Hyperion Financial Management) and Excel-based tools. Perform detailed variance analysis (Actual vs Budget vs Forecast) and provide actionable insights for management decision-making. 8 
 Management Reporting & Performance Review: Prepare and deliver monthly performance presentations to the Engineering Director and Group Engineering Head , highlighting key financial results, cost trends, and operational variances. Present analysis with improvement recommendations to drive business and engineering efficiency. 9 
 Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management: Interact with the global management team on all finance-related topics including reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and compliance. Collaborate closely with plant finance and cross-functional engineering teams to support financial planning, cost control, and performance improvement initiatives. 10 
 Budgeting and Forecasting: Lead the annual budgeting and periodic forecasting process. Track performance, analyze deviations, and support strategic planning and target setting. 11 
 Taxation: Manage Direct Tax and Indirect Tax (GST) compliance, return filing, reconciliations, and assessments. Ensure adherence to statutory deadlines and effective tax planning within the regulatory framework. 12 
 Audit Management: Coordinate and manage Statutory Audit , Tax Audit , Transfer Pricing Audit , and Internal Audit . Partner with auditors to ensure effective audit execution, timely completion, and implementation of recommendations. 13 
 SAP and Oracle Expertise: Proficient in SAP (FI/CO module) for financial accounting, cost center reporting, and asset management, and Oracle HFM for financial consolidation, MIS, budgeting, and forecasting. Drive process automation, accuracy, and system-based financial control. 14 
 Costing and Engineering Rate Analysis: Perform cost analysis and engineering hourly rate calculations to support pricing, project costing, and profitability assessment. Presentations for rate and discussion at various stages, Hours booking reminders and follow up, 15 
 Knowledge of SEZ compliance
